build_zero_shot_classifier: build a ZeroShotClassifier module with random weights for zero-shot classification on a given number of classes
create_classifier_from_config: create a ZeroShotClassifier instance from a Detectron2 config object and input shape specification
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ZeroShotClassifier with input features and an optional custom classifier tensor
